subject: general
question: Which bio-reserves of India are NOT included in the world network biosphere-reserve?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is situated in **Assam**, covering parts of the districts of Kokrajhar, Chirang, Baksa, Udalguri, and Darrang.
 
• It is a core part of the biosphere reserve and a **UNESCO World Heritage Site.**
 
• It was designated as a Tiger Reserve in **1973** under Project Tiger.
 
• It lies along the banks of the **Manas River**, which flows into Bhutan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve:**

 
 
• It is included in the** **UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves (**2001**).
 
• It is known for its rich **marine** biodiversity, including coral reefs and endangered species like the dugong.
 
 
 
• **Sunderbans Biosphere Reserve:**
 
 
• It is part of the UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves (**2001**).
 
• It is famous for the **Royal Bengal Tiger** and is one of the largest** mangrove ecosystems **in the world.
 
 
 
• **Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve:**
 
 
• It is recognized by the UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves (**2004**).
 
• It is known for the **Nanda Devi** and **Valley of Flowers National Parks**, which harbor rare Himalayan flora and fauna.
